question: Under what temporal condition of practice is old age and death said to be destroyed, according to this statement?
premises: That practice is carried out for one year.
When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: If the practice is performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The identity of the practice is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
